title: Fixed L-Frame Training Hurdle
description: One original fixed-height athletics training hurdle visual prop. Two complete one-piece L-shaped side frames combine tall uprights, sloped elbow transitions, long rearward runners and raised distal tails. A continuous full-thickness striped top crossbar meets two finite upright caps; four broad ground pads support both runners. Seven closed connected editable meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, one whole prop and zero scenes. Metres, Z up, front -Y, ground Z=0. Entirely new geometry; no old goal, net, barrier, board or furniture models. Fixed stylised display only: no height adjustment, detachable mechanism, tipping resistance, real training suitability, event regulation, athletics certification, load, manufacture, installation or safety claim. No athlete, track, ball, text, logo, texture or animation.
